howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询《The Web Handbook》文档，提供概念解释、API 参考、代码示例和最佳实践。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于 web、HTML 或文档相关的问题，或要求查找代码示例、API 用法时触发。

say.text: 《The Web Handbook》里怎么安装那个工具？
say.note: Claude 会从文档中提取安装步骤。

say.text: 给我一个 Python 的 API 使用示例。
say.note: Claude 会返回文档中的 Python 代码示例。

say.text: 文档里有哪些常见错误？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the 'The Web Handbook' documentation to provide concept explanations, API references, code examples, and best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about web, HTML, or documentation-related topics, or requests code examples or API usage.

say_en.text: How do I install the tool from 'The Web Handbook'?
say_en.note: Claude will extract installation steps from the docs.

say_en.text: Give me a Python API usage example.
say_en.note: Claude will return a Python code example from the docs.

say_en.text: What common errors are in the docs?
say_en.note: Claude will list the Troubleshooting section.
